title: Product Data Analyst
description: General Information Locations : Hyderabad, Telangana, India Role ID 216652 Worker Type Regular Employee Studio/Department EA Mobile - Slingshot Games (India) Work Model Hybrid Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Product Analyst Will Report To Manager,Analytics About Electronic Arts EA is seeking a Product Analyst to turn player and game data into insights across a mobile portfolio spanning lifestyle and fashion simulations (such as Covet Fashion) and casual strategy and simulation games (such as Plants vs. Zombies). Working with product managers, designers, engineers, and analysts, you'll measure game health, evaluate features and live operations, and help teams make data-informed decisions that improve player experience and business outcomes. About the Role EA is looking for a Product Analyst to turn player and game data into relevant insights across mobile games such as Covet Fashion and Plants vs. Zombies. You'll partner with teams to measure game performance, evaluate features and live operations, and data-informed decisions that enhance player experience and outcomes. What You'll Do You will Analyse Player & Game Performance: Analyse player journeys, engagement, progression, monetization, virtual economies, and game-health metrics to identify opportunities and issues. Our mission is to build Reliable Data Solutions: Use SQL and Python or R to analyse large-scale telemetry; maintain reusable queries and workflows. Promote Self-Service Decisions: Build dashboards and reports that surface Indicators, trends, and operational performance for product teams. Design Experiments: Design A/B tests using sound statistical methods to measure the impact of features, live operations, and player-experience improvements. Define Telemetry & Success Metrics: Partner with Product and Engineering to plan instrumentation, Indicator frameworks, and measurement for new features and live operations. Automate & Strengthen Analytics: Automate recurring analyses and monitoring; validate data and methods to ensure accurate, reporting. Turn Questions into Action: Frame ambiguous business problems, develop hypotheses, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and creative partners. Build Game & Business Context: Develop understanding of mobile free-to-play games, player motivations, virtual economies, live-service operations, and portfolio priorities. What You Bring 2–4 years of experience in analytics or product analytics, using quantitative analysis to guide decisions; mobile free-to-play experience. We have to write and increase SQL queries to extract large datasets. Help us to Design and interpret A/B tests using statistical concepts such as significance, power, and variance. Our mission is proficiency in Python or R, with experience in data analysis, statistical modelling, or workflow automation. Help us to build dashboards and visualisations using BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, and similar platforms. You will present analytical recommendations to partners, including technical and creative partners. Your experience with mobile live-service games, player behaviour analytics, telemetry, or virtual economies. Interest in lifestyle or fashion simulations (such as Covet Fashion) or casual strategy and simulation games (such as Plants vs. Zombies). Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and operational analytics. About Electronic Arts We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do. Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. description: Description Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses. This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside, you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time, that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models. The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you. What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet, they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication, and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports, is what will make you exceptional in this role. Establish Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs, apply statistical methodologies, and develop rigorous approaches to measure model effectiveness, incremental impact, and financial benefits. Drive Technical Excellence: Establish best practices for data quality, analytical accuracy, automation, and solution scalability while improving existing BI processes and frameworks.
